scenes.title: No AC needed.
lines: Your home doesn't need AC to stay cool.
Here are 3 tricks we use at Woodland Architects for coastal homes.

scenes.title: Deep roof overhangs
lines: A 3-foot projection shades your walls, so they don't soak up heat all afternoon.

scenes.title: Cross ventilation
lines: Windows on opposite walls let the sea breeze flow straight through every room.

scenes.title: Open courtyard
lines: Hot air rises out, and cooler air is pulled in from below.
It works like a natural chimney.

scenes.title: Design it right once.
lines: Design it right once, and your home keeps you cool for decades.

end_lines: Follow for more smart home design.
caption:
3 ways to keep your home cool without AC 🌴 Deep overhangs, cross ventilation and an open courtyard — passive cooling that works for decades.
